name: Tell Me! [2 Player Obby]
desc:
⚠️ This game is made for 2 players, to get the best experience play with a friend. ⚠️

Climb out of the pit where 1 of you is blind but can move and the other one can see but cannot move

One must tell the other person what to do 
One must listen and do what the other player is saying

⛰️ Current maximum altitude: 600 M
Game Developer: @sktvladimir535
Thumbnail and Icon: @SpawkleB

Like, Favorite and Follow the game for more updates ❤️
We appreciate your support :)
